Synopsis:
    US equities closed lower on Sept 9, 2026, pressured by oil breaking above $100/bbl driven by US-Israeli/Iran war tensions, rising 10-year Treasury yields hitting their highest since Nov 2023, and a smaller-than-expected Treasury bond buyback ($6B vs. $8-10B anticipated). Broad market weakness was partially offset by a Meta surge (+6%) on AI assistant news. Key near-term focus is on Thursday PPI and Friday CPI data, with markets pricing a 60% probability of a Fed rate hike at the upcoming policy meeting. S&P 500 sits ~2% off its Aug 13 record high but remains +12% YTD.
